description: This file defines a final class ImmutableSearchResultBuilder in Java, which implements the SearchResultBuilder interface. It provides a fluent API for constructing ImmutableSearchResult objects, encapsulating a JsonArrayBuilder and additional properties such as offset and cursor. It includes static factory methods for creating new builder instances, either fresh or initialized from existing SearchResult objects, and methods for adding, removing, and setting properties for search results.

classes.name: ImmutableSearchResultBuilder
classes.description: A mutable builder class for constructing ImmutableSearchResult objects with fluent method calls. It supports setting pagination parameters and manipulating the JSON array of search items.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Creates a new builder instance with initial properties, setting the next page offset to a default value.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a new builder initialized with properties from an existing SearchResult object.

methods.name: nextPageOffset
methods.description: Sets the offset for the next page of search results.

methods.name: cursor
methods.description: Sets the cursor string for pagination.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds one or more JsonValue items to the internal JsonArray of search results.

methods.name: addAll
methods.description: Adds multiple JsonValue items to the internal JsonArray of search results.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a specified JsonValue from the internal JsonArray.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds and returns an ImmutableSearchResult object based on the accumulated data.
